appSubtitle: Turn a client call into a complete scoping package — proposal, architecture, cost and plan — in an hour.

admin.title: Admin account
admin.body: Admin accounts manage the platform and don't create projects. Head to the admin dashboard for users, revenue, and traffic stats.

staff.heading: Staff console
staff.subtitle: You have a staff account. Jump into the tools your role grants — staff accounts don't create projects.
staff.empty: Your account has staff permissions but no console is available yet.

support.title: Support console
support.body: Work customer tickets, replies, and the AI copilot.

analytics.title: Analytics dashboard
analytics.body: Users, revenue, traffic, and platform KPIs.

roles.title: Roles & staff
roles.body: Manage roles, permissions, and staff accounts.

projects.heading: Your client scopings
projects.formHelp: Paste the notes from your client call — the AI interviews you to fill the gaps, then generates the full scoping package: requirements, architecture, database, API, cost, roadmap, and a client-ready link.
projects.emptyHelp: Start your first client scoping — bring your client's answers from the call, run the AI interview, and send them a polished proposal within the hour.
projects.ideaPlaceholder: e.g. A clinic management system with appointments, billing, doctors, and patient records.
projects.ideaTooShort: Add a bit more detail (a sentence or so) to begin.

card.copyLocked: Finish the design (through the database) to share a link with your client.

starters.heading: Not sure where to start? Pick an example — you can edit it before starting:

booking.label: Home-services booking app
booking.idea: A booking app for home-cleaning and handyman services, where customers pick a service, schedule a time slot, pay online, and rate the provider afterwards.

marketplace.label: Marketplace for handmade goods
marketplace.idea: An online marketplace for independent makers to sell handmade goods, with seller storefronts, product listings, a shopping cart, checkout, and order tracking.

saas.label: Team analytics SaaS
saas.idea: A SaaS dashboard that lets teams connect their data sources, build charts, and share live analytics dashboards, with workspaces, roles, and subscription billing.

internal.label: Internal inventory tool
internal.idea: An internal operations tool for a warehouse to track inventory, purchase orders, and stock levels across locations, with barcode lookups and low-stock alerts.

mobile.label: Fitness app backend
mobile.idea: A mobile backend for a fitness app that stores workouts and progress, syncs across devices, sends reminders, and lets users follow coaches and share achievements.

banner.title: Explore a finished example
banner.body: Browse everything the AI produces — vision, requirements, architecture, database, API, review, roadmap, cost, security, and QA plan — before you build your own.

example.intro: This is a read-only sample so you can see what Archivato produces. Every tab below is the output of a different AI agent. It doesn't count against your plan. When you're ready, start your own — it takes a short interview.
example.name: HomeHelper — on-demand home-services booking

confirm.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the scoping and all of its artifacts (requirements, designs, review, history). This cannot be undone.
confirm.leaveBody: You have unsaved edits on this stage. Leaving now will discard them.

toast.linkFailed: Could not create the client link
toast.linkIncomplete: Finish the design (through the database) before sharing a link.
toast.exportIncomplete: Finish generating the design before exporting.
